mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) above 700.0 indicate strengthening residential investment and consumer confidence, which signals improved economic activity and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 700.0 over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate decline below 0.25% signals aggressive monetary easing, compressing discount rates for equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of triggered periods (FEDFUNDS < 0.25%) over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 8.0%) suppress consumer spending and corporate profit growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when UNRATE > 8.0% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous industrial production growth (INDPRO > 98.0) and GDP expansion (GDPC1 > 13500.0) signal robust economic momentum, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both INDPRO > 98.0 and GDPC1 > 13500.0 over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL > 229.0) triggers hawkish monetary policy, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 229.0 over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained non-farm payroll growth above 133,000 thousand indicates a strong labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS > 133000 over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Accommodative monetary policy (FEDFUNDS < 0.2%) combined with rising consumer credit (RSAFS > 400000) supports consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary easing and strong consumer credit
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both RSAFS > 400000 and FEDFUNDS < 0.2% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production decline below 95.0 signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate profits and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0 over a 5-year rolling window.
